name: Chevening Scholarships
subject: All fields (eligible courses)
description: UK government scholarship for eligible applicants to pursue a one-year master's degree at a UK university.
eligibility: Eligibility depends on nationality, work experience, academic and other programme requirements. Check the current country-specific guidance.
benefits: Typically includes tuition, travel and living-related support as described in the official award terms.
deadline: Check the official website for the current application cycle.

name: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters
subject: Multiple disciplines
description: International joint master's programmes delivered by partnerships of higher education institutions.
eligibility: Requirements, participating countries and selection criteria vary by individual programme.
benefits: Some selected students receive scholarships that contribute to participation costs and living expenses; check each programme.
deadline: Different deadlines apply to each master's programme.

name: Fulbright Foreign Student Program
subject: Multiple disciplines
description: Graduate study and research opportunities in the United States for applicants from participating countries.
eligibility: Country-specific eligibility, fields and application procedures apply. Applicants should use the official Fulbright country page.
benefits: Award components vary by country and programme.
deadline: Check the relevant country's Fulbright commission or U.S. Embassy.

name: DAAD Scholarship Database
subject: Multiple disciplines
description: Searchable official database of funding opportunities for study, research and academic exchange in Germany.
eligibility: Each scholarship has its own nationality, academic, language and subject requirements.
benefits: Funding amounts and covered costs differ by award.

name: Research Training Program (RTP)
subject: Research fields
description: Australian Government funding framework supporting eligible domestic and overseas students undertaking higher degrees by research.
eligibility: Universities administer RTP scholarships and set application and selection processes.
benefits: May include tuition fee offset, stipend and allowances, depending on the university award.

name: National Scholarship Portal (NSP)
subject: Scheme-specific
description: Government of India portal for eligible central and selected state scholarship schemes.
eligibility: Eligibility, income limits, category requirements and academic criteria depend on the individual scheme.
benefits: Benefits vary by scheme. Read the official scheme guidelines.
deadline: Check the portal for current scheme dates and notices.
